holds.name: @babel/core
holds.reason: React Compiler Babel fallback (vite.config.ts): on @babel/core 8 every published babel-plugin-react-compiler (1.0.0 and 0.0.0-experimental-a1856f3-20260507, the newest build, 2026-05-08) silently skips components with a destructured default. react#36868 and its fix PRs #36956/#37492 are still open on 2026-10-10. Recheck every sweep; drop the hold (and the Babel fallback) once a fixed compiler build ships or the Oxc WASI binding replaces the fallback.

holds.name: node
holds.reason: The 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-10 Node nightlies publish no win-x64 build (only osx/linux/aix), so pnpm cannot provision devEngines.runtime on this repo's Windows host and CI leg (ERR_PNPM_PACKAGE_MANAGER_NO_MATCHING_PLATFORM_VARIANT). 2026-10-08 is the newest nightly with win-x64. Recheck every sweep; move as soon as a newer nightly ships win-x64.
